title: slogger LogRecord
description: One flattened JSON object emitted by slogger's JSONFormatter. Additional properties are user context (or ctx_-prefixed collisions with reserved names).

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp with milliseconds, e.g. 2026-09-26T16:23:56.239Z, unless datefmt overrides it.

level.description: Stdlib level name such as DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.

file.description: Source filename of the call site.

func.description: Function name of the call site.

line.description: Line number of the call site.

exception.description: Formatted traceback when exc_info was set.

stack.description: Formatted stack dump when stack_info was set.

duration_ms.description: Span duration in milliseconds; present on span.end.

error_type.description: Exception class name when status is error.

error.description: Exception message when status is error.

trace_id.description: 32-character hex trace id shared by a span tree.
